items.title: 5 day shipping forecast updated as of 25 November 2026 5:30am
items.description:
##Today##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds at first.


##Wind)##

Southeast 4 to 6, soon decreasing 3 to 5.


##State of sea)##

Slight, occasionally moderate at first.


##Weather)##

Patchy rain at first, mainly in the west, imminently becoming fair.


##Visibility)##

Good, occasionally moderate in rain at first.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 7°C and max. air temperature 8°C
##Sea Temperature##

12°C
##Tomorrow##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds developing late morning, gales later.


##Wind)##

Southeast 3 to 5, increasing 5 or 6, then 6 to gale 8 later.


##State of sea)##

Slight, becoming moderate, then becoming moderate or rough later.


##Weather)##

Rain later.


##Visibility)##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain later.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 6°C and max. air temperature 9°C
##Sea Temperature##

12°C
##Friday, 27 November 2026##


##Warnings)##

Strong to gale force winds at first.


##Wind)##

Southeast 6 to gale 8, soon becoming west or variable 2 to 4 in most waters for a time mid-late morning, though remaining southeast 5 or 6 in the northeast of the area. Then becoming south or southeast 3 to 5 in all waters in the afternoon.


##State of sea)##

Moderate or rough, becoming slight or moderate in the afternoon.


##Weather)##

Rain at first.


##Visibility)##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain at first.


##Temperature##

12°C

Slight, occasionally moderate.
